title: Apricot Sorbet Recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 4 sprigs of fresh mint, for garnish
ldInstructionsRaw: Place the sugar and water into a pan, bring to the boil then remove from the heat and set aside to cool
Once cool, add the apricot purée to the syrup and mix well to combine. Churn in an ice cream maker, then freeze in a sealable container until needed. Serve with some fresh mint leaves
